job.title: Graduate Research Assistant
description: Design controllable-generation objectives that combine representation-level intervention, contrastive learning, semantic preservation, and LLM-based evaluation.
Co-developed CEBERT, which reached 85.9% accuracy under word replacement and 86.0% under misspelling attacks, outperforming the strongest reported baselines.
Developed a Minimum Description Length framework for detecting adversarial perturbations without access to the original input, published in Entropy in 2024.
Build reproducible evaluation pipelines spanning SBERT similarity, BERTScore, classifier metrics, LLM-as-a-judge workflows, experiment tracking, and failure analysis.
